title: ArcCivs 0.1.37: builder material custody, free water and explicit Creative testing grants
assumptions: Low/base/high are illustrative 1/10/16 participating city owners, not measured ordinary player income. Construction water/waterlogged/filled-cauldron placements per owner-day:1/16/64; farm irrigation repairs:1/4/16. These are sensitivity inputs, not an enforced daily limit.

All building levels share CivsMaterials requirements. Water blocks, waterlogging and cauldron filling cost zero WATER_BUCKET after; base cauldron/block item, lava and powder-snow costs stay. Existing prepaid receipts are not refunded. Original row grouping remains stable for persisted batch cursors.

Before construction consumes one water bucket per charged water/waterlogged cell without an empty-bucket refund. Before farmer repair exchanges one real WATER_BUCKET for one BUCKET. After both place water without consuming or creating bucket items. Water blocks can be collected with a player's own bucket; native renewable water already exists. No inventory bucket faucet is added.

Nine authored farm variants cover all three styles/levels: medievaloak has four existing irrigation cells, nordic/caledonia one initially dry cell each. Automatic repair remains confined to authored irrigation cells with normal permissions, world validation and durable block receipts.

Construction storage routing moves existing items to builder huts and real builder bags; exact schematic non-water costs, native inventories, player debit, paid reservations and replay protection remain. This is custody/transfer correction with zero additional normal-player item issuance.

Existing admin material grants remain. New explicit Creative grants admit creative city managers without requiring admin permission or real source inventory. Illustrative incremental issued mixed-item counts per owner-day are64/2048/27648 (1/4/16 grants at64/512/1728 fitting-item average); not guaranteed fit, not economic valuation and not a lifetime cap. Actual grant is only deficit fitting selected physical destination. Taking items out then granting again can issue more, as existing Creative/admin capabilities can.

Direct Vault, tokens and player XP delta is0. Administrative/Creative item resale may feed current SELL/player trade/contracts, but no material-specific redemption prices or normal-player savings are inferred. Planned SELL-to-contract transition is not assumed active.

Current read-only168h ledger succeeded at1792587379667:3706records,37518operations,30players. Typed currencies separate tokens(62mint/21burn) and Vault(67712749.7876233mint/2862234.6599999983burn), unknownNet0. Mixed legacy totals are not used. One boundary-crossing record/two operations excluded; audit is network background, not attribution to ArcCivs grants.

Removing missing-supply stalls and travel can improve realized throughput without changing production output, growth checkpoints, work durations or native-drop caps. Care limits and hunger remain existing mechanics. No price/progression change, so days-to-save is unknown/not recomputed.

Worker night recovery and courier return do not grant goods or work credit. Stronger existing-path preference can change travel time, not intrinsic job output. Path widening is reused from Trails rather than a new block/item grant.
